purpose: Recovery execution support: produce a current later-stage commercial action queue from durable ledger so PRI stops broad-search reset and resumes stateful conversion.
prohibited: No lifecycle promotion without external receipt
done: Receipt must contain ranked nonterminal PRI records with exact state, due time, next action, recipient/thread where present, and stale/overdue flags.
command:
import json,datetime,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path("overdrive/opportunities.json")
d=json.loads(p.read_text())
records=d.get("records",{})
terminal={"CLOSED_NO_FIT","PAID","SETTLED","REJECTED","CLOSED","EXHAUSTED"}
prio={"RESPONDED":0,"ENGAGED":1,"NEGOTIATING":2,"CONTRACTED":3,"INVOICED/RECEIVABLE":4,"QUALIFIED":5,"SUBMITTED":6,"DELIVERY_FAILED":7}
now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
out=[]
for key,v in records.items():
    if v.get("execution_owner")!="PRI": continue
    st=str(v.get("state","UNKNOWN"))
    if st in terminal: continue
    due=v.get("due_at")
    overdue=False
    if due:
        try: overdue=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(due.replace("Z","+00:00"))<=now
        except Exception: pass
    out.append({"key":key,"organization":v.get("organization"),"state":st,"overdue":overdue,"due_at":due,"last_action_at":v.get("last_action_at"),"next_action":v.get("next_action"),"recipient":v.get("recipient"),"thread_id":v.get("thread_id"),"priority":prio.get(st,50)})
out.sort(key=lambda x:(0 if x["overdue"] else 1,x["priority"],x["due_at"] or "9999"))
print(json.dumps({"generated_at":now.isoformat(),"count":len(out),"top":out[:15]},indent=2))
